description: Input: the same fields as quote_candidate. Make a shot candidate of a run made by make_faceless (paid): a NEW run of skill edit_shot that generates one picture or clip for one shot, to keep or discard in a later revision. Call quote_candidate first and show the user the price. A delivered candidate is charged its one unit whether it is kept or discarded; one that fails is charged nothing. An identical request returns the same run it started before, so a call repeated after a lost answer starts nothing new; to make another candidate with the same request on purpose, pass take 2. An original has a limit on candidates running at once and on candidates failed or unfinished, apart from its revisions; a refusal names which. While shot candidates are closed it answers editing_disabled and charges nothing. The result is a new run: call get_run with its poll.arguments; once it succeeded, its candidate.preview_url shows what was made. Price: picture: 7 credits per image; clip: 49 credits per clip; clip with a new picture: 56 credits per clip. Quote first with quote_candidate; list_prices names every price.
name: create_candidate
title: Make a shot candidate
